COD: Black Ops Cold War and Warzone kicks off S2


Call of Duty / COD: Black Ops Cold War and Warzone kicks off S2, delivering incredible amounts of free content including a brand-new Zombies experience, six free-to-acquire weapons, four new maps, new points of interest in Verdansk, and much more. From now till 5 March at 2am (GMT +8), you can play a selection of Multiplayer and Zombies content, including the all-new Outbreak experience, for free as part of the game’s new Free Access Week.



The next chapter of the Dark Aether story takes the agents of Requiem deep into the heart of Russia, where they’ll fight to survive their greatest challenges yet. Welcome to Outbreak: an entirely new, large-scale Zombies experience unlike any other!



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   Continuing the Dark Aether story, Outbreak takes place across massive play spaces throughout the Ural Mountains, packed with new enemies, team objectives, player rewards, and intel to discover on foot, in vehicles, or by jump pads. Whether its hunting down elite enemies using a satellite tracker, escorting a Rover that detects dimensional portals, or holding out against zombies in a confined Dark Aether zone, agents of Requiem will need to complete these investigations before they can Exfil. or risk entering a Dark Aether portal to a new region for even more rewards.
Along with kicking off a new season of content, these updates will also include quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes to the current Black Ops Cold War and Warzone games. For more information on the content of these updates, consult Treyarch’s Game Intel blogs for Black Ops Cold War patch notes, and Raven Software’s Twitter and forthcoming blog for Warzone patch notes.

reference_summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War dan Warzone telah melancarkan Musim 2, menawarkan sejumlah besar kandungan percuma sehingga 5 Mac jam 2 pagi (GMT +8). Kandungan tersebut termasuk pengalaman Zombi baharu yang dipanggil "Wabak," yang menampilkan permainan berskala besar di seluruh Pergunungan Ural Rusia, lengkap dengan musuh baharu, objektif pasukan, ganjaran dan intel. Pemain boleh mengambil bahagian dalam Minggu Akses Percuma, mencuba pilihan kandungan Berbilang Pemain dan Zombi. Kemas kini juga membawa peningkatan kualiti hidup dan pembetulan pepijat kepada kedua-dua permainan. Lihat blog Intel Game Treyarch untuk nota tampalan Black Ops Cold War dan Twitter dan blog Raven Software untuk nota tampalan Warzone.
